[P2] Order retry observations before constructing the attempt list

`events` retains `cloud.events.values()` insertion order. When multiple native requests are first collected together, that order follows the S3 request-key listing rather than execution chronology; `_causal_order()` assigns sequence fields without reordering the list. A successful retry can therefore precede its failed predecessor here, causing the validator's first-failed/last-successful check to reject a conforming SDK. Sort retry bodies by their recorded causal timing before emitting attempts, and test a batch whose request IDs sort opposite to execution order.
